entities.summary: Theodor Wolfgang Hänsch is a German physicist. He received one-fourth of the 2005 Nobel Prize in Physics for "contributions to the development of laser-based precision spectroscopy, including the optical frequency comb technique", sharing the prize with John L. Hall and Roy J. Glauber.

entities.summary: Theodor Wolfgang Hänsch is a German physicist. Hall and Roy J. Glauber.
